identity.description: An attacker uses an interactive shell inside a privileged Kubernetes container to execute host reconnaissance tools. Cortex should detect this suspicious process execution in a privileged container context. The attack uses wget to fetch a sample to scratch, stubs execution, and connects to TEST-NET-1 for C2.

biocs.name: Suspicious process execution in a privileged container
biocs.description: Process execution inside a privileged container with host-recon tools
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/recon-tool'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name contains 'privileged'
